# Spellstick announcer: recording script

<!-- Generated by `npm run announcer:script` from src/content/announcer.ts. Edit the lines there, not here. -->

28 lines. Each one is a separate file, named by its id. The game picks a line when the moment happens and shows it as text at the bottom of the screen; if there's a recording for it, it's spoken too.

## The voice

- An arena announcer for a brutal, magical sport played by witches: big, warm, a little theatrical, having the time of their life.
- Short and punchy. Most lines should be under 1.5 seconds, none over about 3. Lines can cut each other off, so a quick read beats a long build.
- Read each line as written. The witch-flavored exclamations are from the Warlock books; say them like set phrases: "Child's Tantrum!", "Crone's Corns!", "Third-witch in!".
- Record two or three takes of anything you like and pick the best; only one file per id goes in.

## Files

- One file per line: `<id>.mp3` (`.ogg` and `.wav` also work), for example `goal-01.mp3`.
- Put them in `src/content/announcer-voice/`, commit, and push. Lines without a file stay text-only, so you can add them a few at a time.
- Mono, 44.1 or 48 kHz, MP3 at 96–128 kbps. Trim tight (no more than about 50 ms of silence at either end). Peaks around −1 dBFS, and keep all lines at a similar loudness.
- If you use a text-to-speech service, paste the delivery note from each section as the voice direction.

## Goal

**When:** A goal is scored.  
**Delivery:** Big and loud; the top of your range. Celebrate.

| File | Line |
| --- | --- |
| `goal-01.mp3` | Crone's Corns! It's in! |
| `goal-02.mp3` | Top shelf! |
| `goal-03.mp3` | Buried it! |
| `goal-04.mp3` | Into the twine! |
| `goal-05.mp3` | Child's Tantrum, what a finish! |

## Overtime winner

**When:** The sudden-death overtime winner. The match is over.  
**Delivery:** The biggest call in the game. Full release, a little longer if it wants to be.

| File | Line |
| --- | --- |
| `otwin-01.mp3` | Crone's Corns, it's over! |
| `otwin-02.mp3` | Child's Tantrum! Sudden death, and that's the game! |

## Pile-up

**When:** A hit in a crowd of players.  
**Delivery:** Gleeful, like a fight just broke out. "Third-witch in" is a set phrase: say it as one.

| File | Line |
| --- | --- |
| `pileup-01.mp3` | Third-witch in! |
| `pileup-02.mp3` | Third-witch in, and it gets ugly! |

## Shot clock violation

**When:** A team runs out the 30-second shot clock.  
**Delivery:** Mock-exasperated, like a ref call.

| File | Line |
| --- | --- |
| `shotclock-01.mp3` | Shot clock! That one belongs to the other side. |
| `shotclock-02.mp3` | Too slow! Shot clock! |

## Crease violation

**When:** An attacker carries the ball into the goalie's crease, or a goal is waved off for it.  
**Delivery:** Firm, like a ref call.

| File | Line |
| --- | --- |
| `crease-01.mp3` | In the crease! Turnover. |
| `crease-02.mp3` | Crease violation! |
